name: Add User exposes reporting manager and reportee options
description:
Objective: Add User exposes reporting manager and reportee options.
Preconditions: Open User Management with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open User Management.
2. Add User exposes reporting manager and reportee options.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The requested change is saved and the resulting state is visible to the user.
